name: localsaml-ui
description: localsaml's web UI. `bun run build` writes ui/dist, which is committed and compiled into the binary.

scripts.stock-diff: for c in $(ls src/components/ui | sed 's/[.]tsx$//'); do out=$(shadcn add $c --diff 2>&1); case "$out" in *'No changes'*) ;; *overwrite*) echo "$c differs from the registry (shadcn add $c --diff shows how)" ;; *) echo "$c could not be checked: $out" ;; esac; done; echo "Compared $(ls src/components/ui | wc -l | tr -d ' ') components with the registry."
